Aasha · Gamma 2, Greater Noida

Special education and learning support in Greater Noida

Aasha provides individualised special education and academic remediation in Greater Noida for children with learning difficulties, including specific learning disabilities.

Call to book an assessmentRequest an appointment

Learning support built around the child

  • Reading and literacy needs, including dyslexia
  • Writing needs, including dysgraphia
  • Mathematics needs, including dyscalculia
  • Learning gaps, classroom participation and school-support planning

Each child’s plan is individualised. The team discusses appropriate goals with the family and reviews progress over time.

What to expect at Aasha

Assessment findings inform individualised learning goals and academic remediation. The team can discuss practical home and classroom support with families, and coordinate with schools with family consent.

Read about our clinical leadership and the consultation-to-therapy care pathway.

Preparing for your first appointment

Bring school feedback, examples of schoolwork and previous assessments if available. Share which tasks cause frustration, what your child enjoys learning and the support already tried at home or school.

Confirm the assessment scope, session arrangements and current fees with the coordination team before booking. Families can ask questions about the proposed plan and how parents can participate.

Learning-disability assessment

Questions families ask

Is special education the same as a learning-disability assessment?

No. Assessment explores the child’s learning profile and support needs; special education provides individualised learning support. The team can explain whether an assessment would help plan the next step.

Where is Aasha Early Intervention Centre?

Aasha is at J-123, J Block, Gamma 2, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310. Call +91 96678 63295 for appointment coordination and directions.

What are Aasha’s clinic hours?

Aasha is open Monday to Saturday from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM and is closed on Sunday. Contact the coordination team to arrange an appointment.

Related Aasha services

Speech and language therapy

Aasha provides individualised speech and language therapy in Gamma 2, Greater Noida, supporting communication, understanding and expressing language, articulation and social communication.

Occupational therapy

Aasha offers occupational therapy for children in Gamma 2, Greater Noida, focusing on fine motor skills, sensory needs, visual-motor coordination and everyday independence.

ABA and behavioural support

Aasha offers individualised ABA and behavioural support in Greater Noida for communication, emotional regulation, positive social participation and everyday life skills.

Child developmental and psychological assessments

Dr. Sana Firdos leads Aasha’s child developmental and psychological assessments in Greater Noida, using cognitive, behavioural and developmental evaluations to guide support.

Child psychiatric consultation

Consult Dr. Anita Sharma at Aasha in Greater Noida for childhood psychiatric and neurodevelopmental concerns, with coordinated psychological assessment and therapy planning.

All child-related care comes under Aasha Child Development & Early Intervention Centre.
